summary: Will Chamberlain is a conservative lawyer and commentator. He relaunched Human Events in 2019 as publisher and editor-in-chief, is senior counsel at the Article III Project founded by Mike Davis, and is vice president for external affairs at the Edmund Burke Foundation. He is one of the drafters of the National Conservatism statement of principles.
